platforms.name: Cross-Platform App (iOS/Android) & Web PWA
platforms.detailedDescription: Sky's The Limit (STL) is a California-based digital community operating as a social network and non-profit accelerator that connects early-stage entrepreneurs with volunteer mentors and financial grant opportunities. I was the Lead Frontend Architect responsible for designing and initializing the entire technical foundation of the project. The greatest engineering achievement was the adoption of a 'Single Codebase' architecture through react-native-web and Webpack 5, allowing the same React Native code to generate the iOS app, the Android app, and the Web system simultaneously (similar to Twitter's architectural model). I acted not only in advanced technical structuring (Twilio, Apollo/GraphQL, E2E) but also in managing and containing technical debt generated by the accelerated expansion to a multinational outsourced development team.
learnings: Universal Architecture (React Native Web): Mastery of absolute code sharing, adapting components, routing, and bundlers (Webpack) so that the React Native base compiled identically and performantly for both Web and Mobile environments simultaneously.
WebRTC & Chat Integration (Twilio): Complex implementation of video conferencing rooms and real-time chat using Twilio SDKs, handling native device permissions and seamless state synchronization.

Rigorous E2E Testing Strategy: Setup and writing of End-to-End tests across two distinct ecosystems: Cypress for the web application and Detox for simulating critical flows on iOS and Android binaries.

Advanced Data Management with GraphQL: Structured graph-based API consumption through Apollo Client, utilizing local queries, optimistic mutations, and subscriptions (via graphql-ws) for real-time features.

Code Governance in Global Teams: Practical (and challenging) experience acting as the guardian of the initial architecture within an ecosystem of multiple offshore developers, requiring constant reviews and adaptation to bottlenecks imposed by technical and human scalability.
